style: Photorealistic quiet village main street at golden hour, stone and half-timbered cottages with flower gardens on the left, tall gum trees arching over an empty road
continuity: the framing, horizon and every landmark remain fixed and the scene settles into the framing shown in Picture 2 at the end of the shot, matching the first frame so the clip can loop.

segments.camera: The camera holds a locked-off static wide shot.
segments.action: Dappled sunlight flickers on the road as the leaves move throughout the shot. The gum leaves overhead sway lightly and the garden flowers stir in a soft breeze throughout the shot. The cottages, the fences and the tree trunks stay still.
segments.sfx: a light breeze through gum leaves
